scope: Fresh private no-host-share 2-vCPU/4-GiB Linux materializer; downloaded immutable inputs, fresh Nix store, locked definition evaluation and clean runtime verification; not full source compilation or production hostile-recipe confinement
temporary_memory: 512-MiB tmpfs for the immutable compressed NAR cache and 2-GiB tmpfs for the fresh destination store, within the configured guest memory. Record guest memory before unmount, stop the builder before runtime verification. No redundant captured cache archive is generated.
method_reason: Separate minimal per-project preparation from the original kernel/VMM development builder, whose retained disk exceeded the original single-environment storage limit
includes_in_timing: offline fixed tool installation and Nix bootstrap
import/verify captured NARs and reevaluate locked definition
native guest xxHash/small-file/Redis and actual CLI/TLS verification
excludes_from_timing: publication/download of immutable NAR, source, bootstrap, base-image and APK inputs
storage_rule: Charge the entire fresh stopped builder namespace, downloaded inputs, exported images, retained receipts/logs/sources, common native runtime and private guest/controller files to one environment; unique regular inodes once, stat blocks*512, no APFS shared-extent or amortized fleet-size claim
source_trust: Use the prior trusted fixed-input publication receipt; independently verify all NAR contents, expected NAR hashes and freshly evaluated definition output path. Do not label this as an independent full source/signature-trust reconstruction
retention: Keep original runtime artifacts, failed runs and the original 13.49-GiB builder observation; delete only verified exported duplicates/intermediates inside owned experimental builders
qualification: Native macOS ARM64 preparation diagnostic; does not qualify missing native Linux hosts, production credential delivery or completed authenticated agent tasks
